Author: Nupur Bhati Bench: Nupur Bhati [2025:RJ-JD:22358]
 HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 5388/2025 Kalyan Singh S/o Ram Singh, Aged About 45 Years, R/o Surawa Police Thana Sanchr District Jalore At Present Lodged In Central Jail, Jodhpur).
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent  Connected With  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 5389/2025 Ram Kanwar wife of Shri Heer Singh, Aged About 50 Years,
Resident Of Jadi Ps Dhanera District Banskantha Gujrat (At Present Lodged In Central Jail, Jodhpur)

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Sarvan Sainee For Respondent(s) : Mr. Sameer Pareek, PP  HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE NUPUR BHATI Order 08/05/2025 1.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the material available on record.

2. The present bail application has been filed under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (B.N.S.S.), 2023 on behalf of the petitioners, who are in custody in connection with F.I.R.
No.150/2014 dated 08.07.2014, registered at Police Station Aahore, District Jalore, for the offences under Sections 420, 406, 409 and 120B of IPC.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the co- accused Bhanwar Singh and Heer Singh have already been enlarged on bail by a Coordinate Bench of this Court in CRLMB No.12613/2024 and 4389/2016 vide orders dated 15.10.2024 and [2025:RJ-JD:22358] (2 of 2)
Kalyan Singh vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jd:22358) on 8 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35757987/
1 [CRLMB-5388/2025] 24.05.2016.

entities.text: Kalyan Singh vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jd:22358)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that the case of the petitioners is not distinguishable from the co-accused.
He further submits that the offences are triable by Magistrate.
He further submits that the trial of the case will take long time and no useful purpose would be served by keeping him behind the bars, therefore, the petitioners may be enlarged on bail.

4. Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor opposed the bail application but is unable to refute the fact that the similarly situated co-accused has been enlarged on bail and the offences are triable by Magistrate.

5. Having regard to the entirety of facts and circumstances of the case as available on record and looking to the fact that the the trial will consume time, thus, without expressing any opinion on the merits/demerits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the petitioners deserves to be released on bail.

6. Accordingly, the bail application filed under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (B.N.S.S.), 2023 are allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioners No.1 Kalyan Singh S/o Ram Singh,, and 2. Ram Kanwar wife of Shri Heer Singh, arrested in relation to F.I.R. No.150/2014 dated 08.07.2014, registered at Police Station Aahore, District Jalore, shall be enlarged on bail provided each of them furnish a personal bond in sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for their appearance before the Court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.
(DR. NUPUR BHATI),J 222-223-amit/-
